tools.name: review_game
tools.description: Get a free move-by-move review of a Chess.com or Lichess game: accuracy, every move classified, the evaluation graph. Takes a game link or a PGN. Returns a lumichess.com review link; for a PGN also the players, result and opening.

tools.name: chess_profile
tools.description: Current ratings and win/loss record of a Chess.com or Lichess player, with links to analyse their games and openings on lumichess.com.

tools.name: fide_rating
tools.description: Look up official FIDE ratings (standard, rapid, blitz), title, federation and birth year by player name or FIDE ID.

tools.name: opening_guide
tools.description: Guide to a chess opening: first moves, ECO codes, how often it is played and how it scores, the main lines and the ideas behind them, from Lumichess opening pages. For other names, lists matching ECO lines.

tools.name: identify_opening
tools.description: Name the opening (ECO code and variation) from a list of moves or a PGN, and say on which move the game left named theory.

tools.name: analyze_position
tools.description: Facts about a chess position from its FEN: side to move, check, checkmate or stalemate, material, all legal moves, the opening name if it is a known opening position, and links to engine analysis and the best move.

tools.name: daily_puzzle
tools.description: Today's Lumichess daily puzzle: the position, rating, themes and solution, with a link to solve it on the board.

tools.name: elo_change
tools.description: Expected score and rating change for a win, draw or loss between two Elo ratings, at a chosen K-factor.
